objective: Resolver exclusivamente las fuentes RBAC canonicas existentes para corregir la politica de Production Quality. Identificar fuentes validas para override, decisiones/rework y configuracion. No crear modulos, acciones, roles ni permisos. No DDL. No DML. No migraciones. No Produccion. No auto-advance.

queries.name: tablajeria_authorization_candidates
queries.sql:
SELECT
    m.ModuloID,
    m.CodigoModulo,
    m.NombreModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion,
    COUNT(DISTINCT prm.RolID) AS active_role_count,
    MIN(r.NivelJerarquia) AS min_nivel,
    MAX(r.NivelJerarquia) AS max_nivel
FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos m
JOIN dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm
  ON prm.ModuloID=m.ModuloID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones a
  ON a.AccionID=prm.AccionID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles r
  ON r.RolID=prm.RolID
WHERE LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) LIKE 'tablajeria%'
  AND UPPER(a.CodigoAccion) IN (
      'AUTORIZAR',
      'CONFIGURAR',
      'GESTIONAR',
      'ADMIN'
  )
  AND ISNULL(m.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(a.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(prm.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(prm.Permitido,0)=1
  AND ISNULL(r.Activo,1)=1
GROUP BY
    m.ModuloID,
    m.CodigoModulo,
    m.NombreModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion
ORDER BY
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion

queries.name: administrative_authorization_candidates
queries.sql:
SELECT
    m.ModuloID,
    m.CodigoModulo,
    m.NombreModulo,
    m.Descripcion,
    m.TipoModulo,
    m.ModuloPadreID,
    a.CodigoAccion,
    COUNT(DISTINCT prm.RolID) AS active_role_count,
    MIN(r.NivelJerarquia) AS min_nivel,
    MAX(r.NivelJerarquia) AS max_nivel
FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos m
JOIN dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm
  ON prm.ModuloID=m.ModuloID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones a
  ON a.AccionID=prm.AccionID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles r
  ON r.RolID=prm.RolID
WHERE ISNULL(m.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(a.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(prm.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(prm.Permitido,0)=1
  AND ISNULL(r.Activo,1)=1
  AND UPPER(a.CodigoAccion) IN (
      'ADMIN',
      'AUTORIZAR',
      'CONFIGURAR',
      'GESTIONAR'
  )
  AND (
       LOWER(ISNULL(m.CodigoModulo,'')) LIKE '%admin%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.CodigoModulo,'')) LIKE '%config%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.CodigoModulo,'')) LIKE '%sistema%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.CodigoModulo,'')) LIKE '%segur%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.CodigoModulo,'')) LIKE '%usuario%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.CodigoModulo,'')) LIKE '%rol%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.NombreModulo,'')) LIKE '%admin%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.NombreModulo,'')) LIKE '%config%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.Descripcion,'')) LIKE '%rbac%'
    OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.Descripcion,'')) LIKE '%permiso%'
  )
GROUP BY
    m.ModuloID,
    m.CodigoModulo,
    m.NombreModulo,
    m.Descripcion,
    m.TipoModulo,
    m.ModuloPadreID,
    a.CodigoAccion
ORDER BY
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion

queries.name: candidate_permission_details
queries.sql:
SELECT
    m.CodigoModulo,
    m.NombreModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion,
    r.CodigoRol,
    r.NombreRol,
    r.NivelJerarquia,
    prm.RestriccionPropietario,
    prm.RestriccionSucursal,
    prm.RequiereAutorizacion,
    prm.NivelAutorizacionRequerido
FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos m
  ON m.ModuloID=prm.ModuloID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones a
  ON a.AccionID=prm.AccionID
JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles r
  ON r.RolID=prm.RolID
WHERE ISNULL(m.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(a.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(prm.Activo,1)=1
  AND ISNULL(prm.Permitido,0)=1
  AND ISNULL(r.Activo,1)=1
  AND UPPER(a.CodigoAccion) IN (
      'ADMIN',
      'AUTORIZAR',
      'CONFIGURAR',
      'GESTIONAR'
  )
  AND (
       LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) LIKE 'tablajeria%'
    OR LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) LIKE '%admin%'
    OR LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) LIKE '%config%'
    OR LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) LIKE '%sistema%'
    OR LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) LIKE '%segur%'
  )
ORDER BY
    m.CodigoModulo,
    a.CodigoAccion,
    r.NivelJerarquia,
    r.CodigoRol

queries.name: current_invalid_policy_sources
queries.sql:
WITH required AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
      ('production_quality.override','AUTORIZAR','auth','ADMIN'),
      ('production_quality.decisions','AUTORIZAR','tablajeria','AUTORIZAR'),
      ('production_quality.rework','GESTIONAR','tablajeria','AUTORIZAR'),
      ('production_quality.standards','CONFIGURAR','tablajeria.config','CONFIGURAR'),
      ('production_quality.devices','CONFIGURAR','tablajeria.config','CONFIGURAR')
    ) v(
        TargetModule,
        TargetAction,
        SourceModule,
        SourceAction
    )
)
SELECT
    req.TargetModule,
    req.TargetAction,
    req.SourceModule,
    req.SourceAction,
    m.ModuloID,
    a.AccionID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(prm.Activo,1)=1
         AND ISNULL(prm.Permitido,0)=1
         AND ISNULL(r.Activo,1)=1
        THEN prm.RolID
    END) AS active_role_coverage
FROM required req
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos m
  ON LOWER(m.CodigoModulo)=LOWER(req.SourceModule)
 AND ISNULL(m.Activo,1)=1
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones a
  ON UPPER(a.CodigoAccion)=UPPER(req.SourceAction)
 AND ISNULL(a.Activo,1)=1
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm
  ON prm.ModuloID=m.ModuloID
 AND prm.AccionID=a.AccionID
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles r
  ON r.RolID=prm.RolID
GROUP BY
    req.TargetModule,
    req.TargetAction,
    req.SourceModule,
    req.SourceAction,
    m.ModuloID,
    a.AccionID
ORDER BY
    req.TargetModule
